description_en: Queries the disabled route entries for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）禁用的路由条目
name: DescribeDisabledExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The token to start the next query.

Leave this parameter empty for the first query.
For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without modifying service resources.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a token from your client to make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other values indicate that the request failed. For more information, see the Error Codes section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the route was created

NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the next-hop is deployed
NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 下一跳实例所属的地域ID

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the error message.

If the ErrMessage parameter returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the DynamicMessage parameter returns DtsInstanceId, the specified DtsInstanceId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsInstanceId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsInstanceId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为10

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query.

If NextToken is empty, it indicates that no subsequent query is to be sent.
If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
查询禁用专线网关路由是否成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of route entries
